invariant.portable_principle: Exact normalized source resemblance is investigation evidence, never proof of semantic equivalence or safe consolidation.
invariant.go_mechanism: One batched Go 1.22+ go/parser helper fingerprints go/format-normalized named function and receiver-method bodies.

tooling.selected: family-local Python orchestrator plus bundled stdlib-only detect_go.go
tooling.version_and_resolution: Discover Go from PATH, require Go >= 1.22, disable module/workspace/toolchain downloads; local verification used go1.26.5.
tooling.closure_mode: Copy only the selected find-duplication skill; no repository Python imports, npm packages, network access, or shared runtime.
tooling.batching: Pass all eligible files through one go run so process startup is paid once per scan.

must_fire: one exact same-file pair with a distinct shape label
non_clean: build-constrained files make the final report partial
malformed source and invalid helper evidence fail atomically
missing or old Go is unsupported

generalized: Batch native syntax files through one compiler-driver process.
Classify generated and build-constrained source explicitly before interpreting an empty result.
Carry partial coverage into both structured and human-readable final artifacts.
Replay the copied on-demand closure and all previously supported language branches.
did_not_generalize: Go AST nodes and receiver rendering.
A universal clone schema or shared parser service.
review_learnings: An all-excluded target must not become a false-clean complete report.
Evidence labels and ranking inputs must distinguish same-file from cross-file clones.
A partial JSON status is insufficient when the agent acts from the Markdown report.

reuse_decision.shared_candidate: generated Go source-policy template for tool preflight, project-relative exclusions, and build classification
reuse_decision.trigger_to_revisit: A later accepted Go skill needs the same behavior and measured duplication makes maintenance worse.

next_decision.recommendation: Reassess the remaining semantic/project Go cohort and select at most three bounded pilots before extracting shared go list or go/types facts.
